authority_status: Local custodial work log only; not an authenticated external registration or authorization receipt.
before_acquisition: The manifest reserved all response measurements and left the training allowlist empty before the new measurement bitstreams were acquired or parsed.

measurement_bitstream_access.aggregate_computation_scope: Baseline means/SDs are evaluated privately only inside the source-defined identity replays requested in the metadata follow-up. No response moments, constants or intermediate projections are released; no models are fitted/scored.

literature_access.note: The source Methods contains an existing aggregate calibration statement embedded in assay description. It was incidentally encountered during primary-methods verification, not computed from deposited responses. Its numerical result is not relayed in the manifest or final handoff; the public excerpt explicitly marks its omission. The original primary article/supplement remain in sealed/primary_sources. Independent lineage review should retain this declared literature exposure.

custody_limit: sealed/ uses restrictive local permissions and is excluded from training allowlists. This does not prevent another process under the same user or an external public-data download. Independent registry/lineage/custody enforcement remains required.
decision: All 179 source groups stay reserved and unallocated. The current Sfp1/carbon protocol is metadata-ineligible; no final partition or response-bearing export is authorized.
